newsitem.title: JAPAN: JGBS TO DRIFT LOWER, AWAIT INVESTOR BUYING.
newsitem.headline: JGBS TO DRIFT LOWER, AWAIT INVESTOR BUYING.

text.p: The key September 10-year Japanese government bond futures contract is expected to drift lower on Thursday, retaining its weakness from the previous day, traders said.
"Investors were detected selling yesterday. The key question for the market right now is -- where will investors begin buying?" said a trader for a trust bank's securities unit.
An aggressive try for the downside is unlikely ahead of the release of key June machinery orders data and forecast for the July-September quarter due on Friday, the trader said.

"Economic fundamentals are still supportive for JGBs, making it difficult to sell aggressively on the downside. There is speculation that the key machinery orders data may not contain very strong numbers," the trader said.
JGBs are likely to find support at around 125.70 on Thursday, a trader for a major brokerage house said.
"The September is likely to be supported at 125.70, because there are not many traders right now who want to sell below that level," the trader for a major brokerage house said.
Dealers will be watching moves in stocks and currencies for clues to direction, the second trader added.
